entries.en: He tried to swat the fly with a rolled-up newspaper.
entries.zh: 他想用卷起来的报纸拍那只苍蝇。

entries.en: The pig pushed its muddy snout through a gap in the fence.
entries.zh: 猪把沾满泥的口鼻伸进围栏的缝隙里。

entries.en: We divided the project into small, achievable goals for each week.
entries.zh: 我们把项目拆成每周可以实现的小目标。

entries.en: The historian examined the nationalistic themes running through the wartime posters.
entries.zh: 历史学家分析了贯穿这些战时海报的民族主义主题。

entries.en: The shelter takes in animals whose previous owners mistreated them.
entries.zh: 这家收容所接收曾遭原主人虐待的动物。

entries.en: The meeting is provisionally scheduled for Thursday, subject to the speaker's availability.
entries.zh: 会议暂定周四举行，具体还要看演讲者是否有空。

entries.en: The tiny silver box was exquisitely engraved with leaves and birds.
entries.zh: 小银盒上精美地雕刻着树叶和鸟儿。

entries.en: The desolation of the abandoned mining village struck every visitor.
entries.zh: 那座废弃矿村的荒凉景象让每位到访者都深受触动。

entries.en: The spelling checker flagged three unfamiliar names in the document.
entries.zh: 拼写检查程序标出了文档中三个不熟悉的名字。

entries.en: Her winter coat was made of heavy blue duffel.
entries.zh: 她的冬大衣是用厚实的蓝色粗呢制成的。

entries.en: He stared unhappily at the broken wheel of his new bicycle.
entries.zh: 他闷闷不乐地盯着新自行车损坏的车轮。

entries.en: She jokingly called the enormous suitcase her portable wardrobe.
entries.zh: 她开玩笑地把那个巨大的行李箱叫作移动衣柜。

entries.en: Such a quiet performance was atypical of the usually energetic band.
entries.zh: 这支平时活力十足的乐队很少有这么安静的演出。

entries.meaningZh: 带耶稣受难像的十字架
entries.en: A small wooden crucifix hung above the chapel's entrance.
entries.zh: 一枚带耶稣受难像的小木十字架悬在礼拜堂入口上方。

entries.en: We shook the rain from our coats in the hotel's vestibule.
entries.zh: 我们在酒店门厅里抖掉了外套上的雨水。

entries.en: The anti camp argued that the proposal would remove the only playground.
entries.zh: 反对阵营认为，这项提案会拆掉唯一的游乐场。

entries.en: In the animation, a glowing fireball streaks across the night sky.
entries.zh: 动画中，一个发光的火球划过夜空。

entries.en: Fold the sheet lengthwise before cutting it into narrow strips.
entries.zh: 先把纸纵向对折，再剪成细条。

entries.en: We found a quiet bistro serving soup near the railway station.
entries.zh: 我们在火车站附近找到一家供应汤品的安静小餐馆。

entries.en: The slowness of the old computer made even simple tasks frustrating.
entries.zh: 旧电脑运行缓慢，连简单的任务都做得令人烦躁。

entries.en: The young goalkeeper played impressively against a much more experienced team.
entries.zh: 面对经验丰富得多的对手，年轻门将的表现令人赞叹。

entries.en: I misplaced the garage key while clearing the kitchen table.
entries.zh: 我收拾厨房餐桌时，不知把车库钥匙放哪儿了。

entries.en: The film's likable hero wins people over by admitting his mistakes.
entries.zh: 电影中讨人喜欢的主人公通过承认错误赢得大家的好感。

entries.en: For this minor misdemeanour, the teacher asked him to stay after class.
entries.zh: 因为这个小过失，老师让他课后留下来。

entries.en: She received special dispensation to submit the assignment after returning from hospital.
entries.zh: 她获得特许，可以出院后再交作业。

entries.en: The children discussed a commandment about honesty during their religious studies lesson.
entries.zh: 孩子们在宗教课上讨论了一条关于诚实的戒律。

entries.en: The stained-glass window depicts the saint's martyrdom beside a crowded city gate.
entries.zh: 彩色玻璃窗描绘了圣人在拥挤城门旁殉教的场景。

entries.en: The workshop occupies a nondescript building behind the supermarket.
entries.zh: 这间工坊位于超市后面一栋毫无特色的建筑里。

entries.en: He carefully adjusted his turban before posing for the family photograph.
entries.zh: 他仔细整理好包头巾，再拍全家福。

entries.en: The survey explored differences in religiosity among members of the same community.
entries.zh: 调查探讨了同一社区成员在宗教虔诚程度上的差异。

entries.en: Her ethnography draws on months of observing daily life in a fishing village.
entries.zh: 她的民族志研究建立在对渔村日常生活数月观察的基础上。

entries.en: He is nominally in charge, but his assistant makes most daily decisions.
entries.zh: 他名义上是负责人，但大多数日常决定由助手作出。

entries.en: The milkman left two glass bottles beside the kitchen door before dawn.
entries.zh: 天亮前，送奶工在厨房门边放下了两个玻璃奶瓶。

entries.en: The archivist found an audiotape of her grandfather describing his childhood.
entries.zh: 档案管理员找到一盘录音磁带，里面是她祖父讲述童年的声音。

entries.en: A sympathizer donated paint and brushes to the striking workers' banner workshop.
entries.zh: 一位支持者向罢工工人制作横幅的工坊捐了颜料和刷子。

entries.en: The restored engine ran marvellously during its first journey along the canal.
entries.zh: 修复后的发动机在首次运河航行中运转得非常好。

entries.en: He used a leaf blower to clear the path after the storm.
entries.zh: 暴风雨后，他用吹叶机清理了小路。

entries.en: The old schoolhouse now holds village meetings and evening art classes.
entries.zh: 旧校舍现在用来举行村民会议和晚间美术课。

entries.en: The lights inexplicably went out, although every nearby building still had power.
entries.zh: 灯莫名其妙地熄灭了，附近其他建筑却都还有电。

entries.en: The doorman held the entrance open while we carried in the boxes.
entries.zh: 我们把箱子搬进去时，门卫扶着入口的门。

entries.en: The inn is reputedly haunted, although our night there was entirely peaceful.
entries.zh: 据说这家客栈闹鬼，不过我们在那里度过了十分安静的一晚。

entries.en: After years of stagnation, sales began rising when the shop introduced deliveries.
entries.zh: 销售多年停滞后，这家店推出配送服务，销量开始上升。

entries.en: You can put the spare chairs anyplace that leaves the doorway clear.
entries.zh: 备用椅子放在哪里都行，只要别堵住门口。

entries.en: The lecture introduced cosmological models that describe how the universe changes over time.
entries.zh: 讲座介绍了描述宇宙如何随时间变化的宇宙学模型。

entries.en: The first-aid kit contained gauze, adhesive tape, and several pairs of gloves.
entries.zh: 急救箱里有纱布、胶带和几副手套。

entries.en: The garden's design encourages the coexistence of food crops and native flowers.
entries.zh: 花园的设计有利于粮食作物和本地花卉共存。

entries.en: Our team remained undefeated until the final match of the season.
entries.zh: 我们队直到赛季最后一场比赛之前都未尝败绩。

entries.en: An unattended suitcase stood beside the empty ticket counter.
entries.zh: 一个无人看管的行李箱放在空着的售票柜台旁。

entries.en: The sofa has removable covers that fit in a washing machine.
entries.zh: 这张沙发的罩子可以拆下来，放进洗衣机洗。

entries.en: The mechanic switched on the compressor before attaching the air hose.
entries.zh: 机械师先启动压缩机，再接上气管。

entries.en: He recklessly climbed onto the slippery roof without checking the ladder.
entries.zh: 他没有检查梯子，就鲁莽地爬上了湿滑的屋顶。

entries.en: The newly discovered letter definitively established who had designed the garden.
entries.zh: 新发现的信件最终确定了花园设计者的身份。

entries.en: A spoonful of molasses gave the bread its dark color and rich flavor.
entries.zh: 一勺糖蜜赋予面包深色外观和浓郁风味。

entries.en: The botanist identified the unfamiliar fern growing beside the stream.
entries.zh: 植物学家辨认出了溪边生长的陌生蕨类。

entries.en: The butcher set aside a meaty bone for the soup.
entries.zh: 肉贩留下一根带很多肉的骨头用来煮汤。

entries.en: We bought waterproof jackets at an outdoor outfitter near the trail entrance.
entries.zh: 我们在步道入口附近的一家户外用品店买了防水夹克。

entries.en: The brass medallion bore the club's emblem and the winner's name.
entries.zh: 黄铜纪念奖章上印有俱乐部徽章和获胜者的名字。

entries.en: A few damp logs continued to smolder after the flames had died down.
entries.zh: 火焰熄灭后，几块潮湿木头还在闷烧。

entries.en: The fortified town could be entered only through a guarded stone gateway.
entries.zh: 这座设有防御工事的城镇只能通过有人把守的石门进入。

entries.en: The exercise uses a notional family of four to compare household budgets.
entries.zh: 这道练习用一个假设的四口之家来比较家庭预算。

entries.en: The abandoned cottage showed no recent signs of human habitation.
entries.zh: 那间废弃小屋没有近期有人居住的迹象。

entries.en: A power outage interrupted the screening halfway through the film.
entries.zh: 一次停电让电影放到一半时中断了。

entries.en: The school corrected misinformation about the trip's departure time in a second email.
entries.zh: 学校又发了一封邮件，纠正了旅行出发时间的错误信息。

entries.en: The caseworker helped the family complete its application for housing support.
entries.zh: 个案工作者帮助这个家庭填写了住房援助申请。

entries.en: She studied hairdressing before opening a small salon with her sister.
entries.zh: 她学过美发，后来和姐姐开了一家小发廊。

entries.en: The two designs are conceptually similar, although their materials differ greatly.
entries.zh: 这两个设计在概念上相似，不过材料差别很大。

entries.en: As a lefty, she found the scissors in the sewing kit awkward.
entries.zh: 她是左撇子，觉得针线盒里的那把剪刀不顺手。

entries.en: The baker increased every ingredient proportionately when making a larger cake.
entries.zh: 烘焙师做更大的蛋糕时，按比例增加了每种原料。

entries.en: The plant has fleshy leaves that feel thick and smooth.
entries.zh: 这种植物的叶子肥厚，摸起来厚实光滑。

entries.en: The young ballplayer stayed after practice to work on his swing.
entries.zh: 这位年轻的棒球手训练后留下来练习挥棒。

entries.en: The missing necklace was returned to the person who rightfully owned it.
entries.zh: 失踪的项链被归还给了它真正的主人。

entries.meaningZh: 找到了（发现答案时的欢呼）
entries.en: "Eureka!" she cried when the last piece finally fitted into the puzzle.
entries.zh: 最后一块终于拼进拼图时，她喊道：“找到了！”

entries.en: The coach challenged the team's passivity after nobody chased the loose ball.
entries.zh: 球无人控制却没人上前争抢，教练因此批评全队消极被动。

entries.en: The final step was insufficiently explained, leaving several students confused.
entries.zh: 最后一步解释得不够充分，让几名学生感到困惑。

entries.en: Thick carpeting muffled our footsteps as we walked along the corridor.
entries.zh: 我们沿走廊前行时，厚地毯减弱了脚步声。

entries.en: The synergy between the engineer's precision and the artist's imagination strengthened the project.
entries.zh: 工程师的精确与艺术家的想象力产生协同效应，使项目更出色。

entries.en: The overworked manager kept answering emails long after the office had closed.
entries.zh: 这位工作过度的经理在办公室关门很久后还在回复邮件。

entries.en: The restoration team repaired the damaged stonework around the church windows.
entries.zh: 修复团队修补了教堂窗户周围受损的石砌部分。

entries.en: She grew contemplative as the conversation turned to their childhood home.
entries.zh: 谈话转到儿时故居时，她陷入了沉思。

entries.en: The child shyly offered the visitor a drawing of the family dog.
entries.zh: 孩子羞怯地把一幅自家狗狗的画递给来客。

entries.en: Residents opposed the gradual encroachment of car parks onto the village green.
entries.zh: 居民反对停车场逐渐侵占村庄公共草地。

entries.en: The tiny, defenceless kitten hid behind a stack of flowerpots.
entries.zh: 那只弱小无助的幼猫躲在一摞花盆后面。

entries.en: The continuance of the evening class depends on finding enough new students.
entries.zh: 夜间课程能否继续，取决于能否招到足够的新学生。

entries.en: The research boat used sonar to map the shape of the lake bed.
entries.zh: 考察船用声呐绘制了湖底地形。

entries.en: Opening the market again brought a sense of normalcy after the flood.
entries.zh: 洪灾后市场重新开放，带来了恢复正常生活的感觉。

entries.en: The cylindrical container rolled off the shelf and across the floor.
entries.zh: 圆柱形容器从架子上滚下来，滚过了地板。

entries.en: The island's remoteness makes every delivery of building materials expensive.
entries.zh: 岛屿位置偏远，每次运送建筑材料都很昂贵。

entries.en: Visitors gathered in the museum forecourt before the doors opened.
entries.zh: 开门前，游客们聚集在博物馆前的空地上。

entries.en: The biology textbook includes a diagram of collagen fibers in connective tissue.
entries.zh: 生物课本中有一幅结缔组织内胶原纤维的示意图。

entries.en: Brown bracken covered the hillside on either side of the narrow path.
entries.zh: 窄路两边的山坡上覆盖着褐色的蕨丛。

entries.en: The shopkeeper dressed the mannequin in a bright red winter coat.
entries.zh: 店主给展示人台穿上了一件鲜红色的冬大衣。

entries.en: The campsite shop sells propane cylinders for use with compatible camping stoves.
entries.zh: 营地商店出售供适配露营炉使用的丙烷气罐。

entries.en: A tiny eatery beside the station serves hot dumplings until midnight.
entries.zh: 车站旁一家小餐馆供应热饺子，一直营业到午夜。

entries.en: The closure agreement included severance pay for everyone losing a permanent position.
entries.zh: 停业协议为所有失去长期职位的员工规定了解雇补偿金。

entries.en: A single ember glowed beneath the ash in the fireplace.
entries.zh: 壁炉的灰烬下面还有一点余火发着红光。

entries.en: His voice sounded unnaturally cheerful when he announced the cancelled trip.
entries.zh: 他宣布旅行取消时，声音显得不自然地轻快。

entries.en: The hospital moved its dialysis unit into a larger room near the entrance.
entries.zh: 医院把透析室搬到了入口附近一间更大的房间。

entries.en: He plunked the heavy toolbox onto the bench beside me.
entries.zh: 他把沉重的工具箱咚的一声放在我旁边的长凳上。

entries.en: The gate opens electrically, but a manual handle is available inside.
entries.zh: 这扇大门由电力开启，不过里面也有手动把手。

entries.en: Her individualistic style stood out among the otherwise uniform exhibition displays.
entries.zh: 她富有个性的风格在其他整齐划一的展品布置中脱颖而出。

entries.en: The letter appears unaltered in the appendix, including its original spelling mistakes.
entries.zh: 信件原样收录在附录里，连原来的拼写错误也保留了。

entries.en: The librarian checked the completeness of the set before buying the second-hand books.
entries.zh: 图书管理员在购买那套二手书前，检查了是否齐全。

entries.en: Two slices of bread popped out of the toaster at once.
entries.zh: 两片面包同时从烤面包机里弹了出来。

entries.en: The journey was unremarkable until a deer appeared beside the road.
entries.zh: 一路都平淡无奇，直到路边出现一只鹿。

entries.en: She attended a physiotherapy appointment before returning to her office that afternoon.
entries.zh: 那天下午，她接受了物理治疗后才回办公室。

entries.en: Heavy velvet drapery framed the tall windows of the drawing room.
entries.zh: 厚重的天鹅绒帷幔围着客厅的高窗。

entries.en: A loose cobblestone shifted beneath the wheel of the delivery cart.
entries.zh: 送货推车的轮子压过时，一块松动的铺路圆石移了位。

entries.en: The children sang merrily while carrying their lanterns through the garden.
entries.zh: 孩子们提着灯笼穿过花园，一路欢快地唱歌。

entries.en: She looked wistfully at the photographs of summers spent in her old village.
entries.zh: 她惆怅地看着那些在旧村庄度过夏天时拍的照片。

entries.en: Both sides agreed to conciliation after direct talks failed to settle the dispute.
entries.zh: 直接谈判未能解决争端后，双方同意接受调解。

entries.en: The dining room was lavishly decorated with silk curtains and enormous crystal chandeliers.
entries.zh: 餐厅装饰奢华，挂着丝绸窗帘和巨大的水晶吊灯。

entries.en: In the story, an enchanted mirror answers the queen's questions.
entries.zh: 故事里，一面被施了魔法的镜子回答王后的问题。

entries.en: One brown loafer had slipped beneath the bed during the hurried packing.
entries.zh: 匆忙收拾行李时，一只棕色平底便鞋滑到了床底。

entries.en: The rider dismounted before leading her horse through the narrow gate.
entries.zh: 骑手先下马，再牵着马穿过窄门。

entries.en: In the family diary, her grandmother often mentions a handsome young beau.
entries.zh: 在家庭日记中，她的祖母常提起一位英俊的年轻男友。

entries.en: They rehearsed intensively for two weeks before taking the play on tour.
entries.zh: 他们密集排练了两周，然后带着这出戏巡演。

entries.en: The novel follows a monk whose vow of celibacy shapes his relationships.
entries.zh: 小说讲述一位僧侣的经历，他的独身誓言影响了他的人际关系。

entries.en: The gatekeeper checked our passes before letting us enter the estate.
entries.zh: 守门人查看了通行证，才让我们进入庄园。

entries.en: The film's hustler sells fake watches to tourists outside the station.
entries.zh: 电影中的骗子在车站外向游客兜售假手表。

entries.en: The documentary examines the police investigation into a convicted pedophile.
entries.zh: 这部纪录片探讨了警方对一名已定罪恋童癖者的调查。

entries.en: The photocopier ran out of paper halfway through printing the handouts.
entries.zh: 复印机印讲义印到一半时没纸了。

entries.en: A neighbor helpfully labeled the switches before lending us the unfamiliar machine.
entries.zh: 邻居把那台我们不熟悉的机器借给我们前，热心地标好了开关。

entries.en: She took the cancellation philosophically and used the free afternoon to read.
entries.zh: 她豁达地接受了活动取消，利用空出的下午读书。

entries.en: The fruit was attractively arranged in shallow baskets near the entrance.
entries.zh: 水果美观地摆放在入口附近的浅篮里。

entries.meaningZh: 制红椒粉用的辣椒植株
entries.en: Paprika plants grew beside the tomatoes in the warm greenhouse.
entries.zh: 制红椒粉用的辣椒植株长在温暖的温室里，紧挨着番茄。

entries.en: The matching fingerprints conclusively linked the suspect to the stolen car in the story.
entries.zh: 故事中，吻合的指纹确凿地将嫌疑人与失窃汽车联系起来。

entries.en: He tenderly brushed a strand of hair from the sleeping child's face.
entries.zh: 他温柔地把一缕头发从熟睡孩子的脸上拂开。

entries.en: Her recitation of the poem brought the noisy classroom to silence.
entries.zh: 她朗诵那首诗时，喧闹的教室安静了下来。

entries.en: Directional arrows on the floor led visitors toward the temporary exit.
entries.zh: 地板上的方向箭头引导游客走向临时出口。

entries.en: The worshippers removed their shoes before entering the prayer hall.
entries.zh: 礼拜者进入祈祷大厅前脱下了鞋子。

entries.en: Her masterful performance made the difficult violin passage sound effortless.
entries.zh: 她技艺高超的演奏让那段很难的小提琴乐句听起来轻松自如。

entries.en: The redhead in the group photograph is my younger cousin.
entries.zh: 合影里那个红头发的人是我年纪较小的表亲。

entries.en: Delivery vans lined the busy thoroughfare behind the central market.
entries.zh: 中央市场后面繁忙的交通要道上停满了送货车。

entries.en: An errant football sailed over the fence and landed in our pond.
entries.zh: 一个踢偏的足球飞过围栏，落进了我们的池塘。

entries.en: Each bowl of tomato soup came with a large meatball.
entries.zh: 每碗番茄汤里都放着一个大肉丸。

entries.en: A partridge emerged from the grass and hurried across the track.
entries.zh: 一只山鹑从草丛里钻出来，匆匆穿过小路。

entries.en: She looped the mooring rope around a metal cleat on the dock.
entries.zh: 她把系船绳绕在码头的金属系缆栓上。

entries.en: A disorderly pile of receipts covered most of the kitchen table.
entries.zh: 一堆杂乱的收据占了厨房餐桌的大半。

entries.en: He caught the edge of the label with his thumbnail and peeled it away.
entries.zh: 他用拇指指甲挑起标签边缘，把它撕了下来。

entries.en: She unzipped the side pocket and took out a folded map.
entries.zh: 她拉开侧袋的拉链，拿出一张折好的地图。

entries.en: In the detective novel, the suspect refuses to take a polygraph test.
entries.zh: 侦探小说中，嫌疑人拒绝接受测谎仪测试。

entries.en: The hotel's manicured lawns contrasted sharply with the wild hillside beyond.
entries.zh: 酒店修剪整齐的草坪与远处荒野般的山坡形成鲜明对比。

entries.en: The goalie dived to her left and pushed the ball away.
entries.zh: 守门员向左扑去，把球挡开了。

entries.en: The meeting became adversarial when each department blamed the other for the delay.
entries.zh: 两个部门互相指责对方造成延误，会议气氛变得针锋相对。

entries.en: The colourless liquid looked like water but had a strong chemical smell.
entries.zh: 那种无色液体看上去像水，却有很浓的化学品气味。

entries.en: He wore a straw boater with a blue ribbon to the summer picnic.
entries.zh: 夏日野餐时，他戴着一顶系蓝丝带的平顶硬草帽。

entries.en: A tuft of grass grew from a crack in the old wall.
entries.zh: 一簇青草从旧墙的裂缝里长了出来。

entries.en: Among our guides, her knowledge of the village's history is unrivalled.
entries.zh: 在我们的向导中，她对村庄历史的了解无人能及。

entries.en: The proposal's unpopularity became clear when nearly everyone voted against it.
entries.zh: 几乎所有人都投了反对票，足见这项提案不受欢迎。

entries.en: The hockey puck slid beneath the goalkeeper's stick and into the net.
entries.zh: 冰球从守门员的球杆下滑过，进了球门。

entries.en: The medical report described a facial palsy affecting one side of his face.
entries.zh: 医疗报告记载，他一侧面部出现了麻痹。

entries.en: The cabinetmaker used ebony for the small decorative handles on the drawers.
entries.zh: 家具木匠用乌木制作了抽屉上的小装饰把手。

entries.en: A toasted marshmallow melted between the warm biscuits and chocolate.
entries.zh: 一块烤过的棉花糖在温热的饼干和巧克力之间融化了。

entries.en: Polishing restored the silver bowl's lustre after years in a cupboard.
entries.zh: 银碗在柜子里放了多年，擦拭后恢复了光泽。

entries.en: The drivers walked around the racetrack before taking their cars out.
entries.zh: 车手们先绕赛道步行查看了一圈，再把赛车开出去。

entries.en: The priest explained the sacramental significance of the bread and wine.
entries.zh: 神父解释了面包和葡萄酒在圣礼中的意义。

entries.en: One windscreen wiper stopped working during the heavy afternoon rain.
entries.zh: 下午下大雨时，一根挡风玻璃雨刷不动了。

entries.meaningZh: 节庆活动（尤指西班牙等地）
entries.en: The village fiesta filled the square with music, dancing, and food stalls.
entries.zh: 村庄的节庆活动让广场上满是音乐、舞蹈和食物摊位。

entries.en: The lecturer provided an illustrative example before introducing the general rule.
entries.zh: 讲师在介绍一般规则前，先给了一个说明性的例子。

entries.en: I foolishly left the windows open before the sudden rainstorm.
entries.zh: 暴雨突然袭来之前，我竟然还把窗户开着。

entries.en: They fervently hoped that the missing dog would return before nightfall.
entries.zh: 他们热切盼望失踪的狗能在天黑前回来。

entries.en: His antagonistic tone made even a simple discussion about chairs turn hostile.
entries.zh: 他敌对的语气，让一场关于椅子的简单讨论也变得充满火药味。

entries.en: The ranger found a poacher's abandoned trap near the forest boundary.
entries.zh: 护林员在森林边界附近发现了一副偷猎者遗弃的捕兽夹。

entries.en: The lecturer drew a diagram showing serotonin carrying signals between nerve cells.
entries.zh: 讲师画了一张图，展示血清素在神经细胞之间传递信号。

entries.en: The benefits of the revised ending remain arguable, despite the editor's enthusiasm.
entries.zh: 尽管编辑很看好，修改后的结尾究竟有何好处仍有争议。

entries.en: The entomologist examined the beetle's wings through a powerful microscope.
entries.zh: 昆虫学家通过高倍显微镜观察了甲虫的翅膀。

entries.en: The realignment of the shelves created enough room for a central worktable.
entries.zh: 重新调整书架位置后，腾出了足够空间放一张中央工作台。

entries.en: Please append a list of sources to the end of your report.
entries.zh: 请在报告末尾附上一份资料来源清单。

entries.en: The interrogator in the film repeats the question until the witness answers.
entries.zh: 电影中的审讯者反复提问，直到证人回答。

entries.en: The novel follows a journalist investigating allegations of molestation at a boarding school.
entries.zh: 小说讲述一名记者调查有关一所寄宿学校内发生猥亵行为的指控。

entries.en: Her scrapbook held concert tickets, newspaper clippings, and photographs from university.
entries.zh: 她的剪贴簿里保存着大学时期的音乐会门票、剪报和照片。

entries.en: The sorority organized a book sale to support the local literacy program.
entries.zh: 女生联谊会举办了图书义卖，支持当地的识字项目。

entries.en: A language purist might object to the slang used throughout the advertisement.
entries.zh: 坚持语言纯正的人可能会反对广告中通篇使用的俚语。

entries.en: The sea looked calm beneath an unchanging stretch of grey sky.
entries.zh: 一片始终不变的灰色天空下，海面显得很平静。

entries.en: The dancers followed a predetermined order when stepping onto the stage.
entries.zh: 舞者们按照预先确定的顺序登台。

entries.en: A broken slat in the fence allowed the puppy to escape.
entries.zh: 围栏里一根断裂的木条让小狗钻了出去。

entries.en: In the opening chapter, an old woman prophesies the king's downfall.
entries.zh: 开篇中，一位老妇人预言国王将会覆灭。

entries.en: Her loathing of dishonesty made the concealed mistake especially difficult to forgive.
entries.zh: 她极其厌恶不诚实的行为，所以尤其难以原谅那个被隐瞒的错误。

entries.meaningZh: 靠妓女收入为生的人（英式英语，旧时贬称）
entries.en: The crime novel follows a detective investigating a ponce who controls several women.
entries.zh: 犯罪小说讲述一名侦探调查一个控制数名女性、靠卖淫收入为生的男子。

entries.en: We cannot generalise from one disappointing meal to every restaurant in town.
entries.zh: 我们不能因为一顿饭不满意，就对城里所有餐馆一概而论。

entries.en: The host graciously welcomed the unexpected guests and found extra chairs.
entries.zh: 主人和蔼有礼地欢迎了不请自来的客人，并找来更多椅子。

entries.en: The hospital moved its orthopaedic clinic to the newly renovated wing.
entries.zh: 医院把骨科门诊搬到了新装修的侧楼。

entries.en: In the play, a penniless nobleman tries to sell his family estate.
entries.zh: 戏中，一位身无分文的男贵族试图卖掉家族庄园。

entries.en: Give the spare ticket to whomever you choose to invite.
entries.zh: 你选谁来，就把多出的票给谁。

entries.en: The film opens with a carefully planned breakout from an island prison.
entries.zh: 电影以一场精心策划的海岛监狱越狱行动开场。

entries.en: The chef expertly folded the thin pastry around the mushroom filling.
entries.zh: 厨师熟练地把薄面皮包在蘑菇馅外面。

entries.en: Convinced of his own righteousness, the character refuses to consider anyone else's view.
entries.zh: 这个人物深信自己正义无比，不肯考虑别人的看法。

entries.en: The painter used subtle tonal changes to suggest light falling across the wall.
entries.zh: 画家用细微的色调变化表现光线落在墙上的效果。

entries.en: She packed a small tube of moisturizer beside her toothbrush.
entries.zh: 她把一小管保湿霜和牙刷一起装进行李。

entries.en: The veterinary report noted a deformity in the rescued bird's wing.
entries.zh: 兽医报告记载，那只获救鸟的翅膀存在畸形。

entries.en: The groundskeeper planted bluegrass in the bare patches around the playing field.
entries.zh: 场地管理员在运动场周围的裸地上种了早熟禾。

entries.en: The suction from the vacuum cleaner pulled the loose thread from the carpet.
entries.zh: 吸尘器的吸力把地毯上松脱的线头吸了起来。

entries.en: The evening class gave new residents a chance to socialise after work.
entries.zh: 夜间课程让新居民有机会在下班后相互交往。

entries.en: A child's red kite rose above the treetops at the edge of the park.
entries.zh: 一个孩子的红色风筝升到了公园边缘的树梢上方。

entries.en: Each apple picker carried a padded bag to protect the fruit.
entries.zh: 每名苹果采摘工都带着有衬垫的袋子来保护果实。

entries.en: Two attendants wheeled the empty gurney down the hospital corridor.
entries.zh: 两名护理员推着空推床走过医院走廊。

entries.en: Her perfectionism kept her revising the opening paragraph instead of finishing the essay.
entries.zh: 她过度追求完美，一直修改开头段落，迟迟没有写完整篇文章。

entries.en: Pursuant to our written agreement, the keys will be returned on Friday.
entries.zh: 根据我们的书面协议，钥匙将于周五归还。

entries.en: The farmer cut the alfalfa and left it to dry before baling.
entries.zh: 农场主割下紫花苜蓿，晾干后再打包。

entries.en: His incapacity to make even small decisions delayed the entire project.
entries.zh: 他连小事都无法决定，拖延了整个项目。
